title: Roleplay Essential
description: A collection of aesthetic items for Roleplay: Smartphone, Driver's License, Cash, and Keys. Lightweight, vanilla-style, and bug-free.
body:
🏙️ Roleplay Essentials
Bring your Minecraft world to life with Roleplay Essentials! This mod adds a collection of must-have modern items designed to fit perfectly into the Vanilla Minecraft aesthetic.

Whether you're building a city, managing a shop, or developing your character's story, these items provide the perfect visual props for an immersive experience.

✨ Featured Items:
📱 Smartphone: The essential modern device. Carry it everywhere!

🪪 Driver's License: A clean ID card for all your official roleplay needs.

💵 Cash: Realistic bills. Perfect for shop decorations or manual trading.

🔑 Keys: Golden keys to represent your home or vehicle ownership.

🚀 Why Roleplay Essentials?
Vanilla Style: Every item features high-quality pixel art that matches the original game style.

Purely Aesthetic: These items are designed as high-stability props. No complex GUIs or scripts means zero crashes and 100% compatibility with other mods.

Lightweight: Minimal impact on game performance, perfect for any server or modpack.

🛠️ Best Usage:
Item Frames: Great for decorating banks, offices, and store counters.

Inventory Immersion: Add that extra layer of realism to your character's gear.

⚠️ Note for Users:
Roleplay Essentials focuses on visual immersion and stability. Items are decorative props without functional GUIs, ensuring a bug-free experience for every player.
